title: Amino-alcohol functionalized porous polymer coupled with chromium hydroxide nanoparticles for efficient Cd(II) adsorption from aqueous solutions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3480-3496
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08579E, Paper
Open Access

Hamida Y. Mostafa, Ahmed M. Masoud, Adel A. El-Zahhar, Majed M. Alghamdi, Entsar H. Taha, Ahmed M. A. El Naggar, Mohamed H. Taha
Cr(OH)3-impregnated-porous polystyrene functionalized by blending with amino-alcohol is presented as a novel adsorbent. Enhanced adsorption capacity was exhibited by this composite during removal of Cd(II) ions.
